title: lp2109759-questing → ubuntu/questing-devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index d7a8eaf..139b633 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+openssh (1:10.0p1-5ubuntu5.5) questing; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/openssh-server.postinst: avoid enabling/restarting ssh.socket if masked
+    (LP: #2109759)
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:43:01 +0200
+
 openssh (1:10.0p1-5ubuntu5.4) questing-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: unexpected scp setuid and setgid
diff --git a/debian/openssh-server.postinst b/debian/openssh-server.postinst
index 91fcc6a..1f7844e 100644
--- a/debian/openssh-server.postinst
+++ b/debian/openssh-server.postinst
@@ -118,7 +118,10 @@ if [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
         systemctl daemon-reload
 
         if deb-systemd-helper --quiet was-enabled ssh.socket; then
-                deb-systemd-invoke restart ssh.socket
+                # avoid restarting if ssh.socket is masked, since that would fail
+                if [ "$(systemctl is-enabled ssh.socket 2>/dev/null)" != "masked" ]; then
+                    deb-systemd-invoke restart ssh.socket
+                fi
         elif deb-systemd-helper --quiet was-enabled ssh.service; then
                 deb-systemd-invoke restart ssh.service
         fi
